title: Appleman and Toastman
statementMd:
Appleman and Toastman play a game. Initially Appleman gives one group of $*n*$ numbers to the Toastman, then they start to complete the following tasks:

- Each time Toastman gets a group of numbers, he sums up all the numbers and adds this sum to the score. Then he gives the group to the Appleman.
- Each time Appleman gets a group consisting of a single number, he throws this group out. Each time Appleman gets a group consisting of more than one number, he splits the group into two non-empty groups (he can do it in any way) and gives each of them to Toastman.

After guys complete all the tasks they look at the score value. What is the maximum possible value of score they can get?

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 3·10^{5}$). The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}$, $*a*_{2}$, ..., $*a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$) — the initial group that is given to Toastman.

## Output

Print a single integer — the largest possible score.

## Note

Consider the following situation in the first example. Initially Toastman gets group [3, 1, 5] and adds 9 to the score, then he give the group to Appleman. Appleman splits group [3, 1, 5] into two groups: [3, 5] and [1]. Both of them should be given to Toastman. When Toastman receives group [1], he adds 1 to score and gives the group to Appleman (he will throw it out). When Toastman receives group [3, 5], he adds 8 to the score and gives the group to Appleman. Appleman splits [3, 5] in the only possible way: [5] and [3]. Then he gives both groups to Toastman. When Toastman receives [5], he adds 5 to the score and gives the group to Appleman (he will throws it out). When Toastman receives [3], he adds 3 to the score and gives the group to Appleman (he will throws it out). Finally Toastman have added 9 + 1 + 8 + 5 + 3 = 26 to the score. This is the optimal sequence of actions.
statementZhMd:
苹果人和吐司人在玩一个游戏。最初，苹果人将一组包含 $*n*$ 个数字的数交给吐司人，然后他们开始完成以下任务：

- 每当吐司人拿到一组数字时，他会将所有数字求和，并把这个和加入得分。然后他将这组数字交给苹果人。
- 每当苹果人拿到只包含一个数字的组时，他会将这组数字丢掉。每当苹果人拿到包含多于一个数字的组时，他会将这组数字分成两个非空的组（分法任意），并将这两组分别交给吐司人。

当他们完成所有任务后，会查看得分。请问他们能够获得的最大得分是多少？

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 3·10^{5}$）。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}$、$*a*_{2}$、...、$*a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$），表示最初交给吐司人的那组数字。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即可能获得的最大得分。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例中的情况。最初吐司人拿到数组 [3, 1, 5]，并将 9 加入得分，然后他将这组数字交给苹果人。苹果人将数组 [3, 1, 5] 分成两组：[3, 5] 和 [1]。这两组都应交给吐司人。当吐司人拿到数组 [1] 时，他将 1 加入得分，然后将这组数字交给苹果人（苹果人会将它丢掉）。当吐司人拿到数组 [3, 5] 时，他将 8 加入得分，然后将这组数字交给苹果人。苹果人只有一种方式可以分割 [3, 5]：将其分成 [5] 和 [3]。然后他将这两组数字都交给吐司人。当吐司人拿到数组 [5] 时，他将 5 加入得分，然后将这组数字交给苹果人（苹果人会将它丢掉）。当吐司人拿到数组 [3] 时，他将 3 加入得分，然后将这组数字交给苹果人（苹果人会将它丢掉）。最终，吐司人加入得分的总和为 9 + 1 + 8 + 5 + 3 = 26。这就是最优的操作序列。
